quarterlyStatements.limitations: Open/free yfinance quarterly statement tables are screening-grade, rate-limited, and may lag or omit line items. Values are shown only when a dated quarterly statement row is returned; no statement history is inferred from current yfinance summary fields. Currency is shown only when yfinance provides financialCurrency.
quarterlyStatements.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance quarterly statement tables

enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.label: EV/EBITDA
enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.limitation: EV currency/component bridge is unverified. No corrected valuation is substituted; passing arithmetic does not reconcile leases, minorities, restricted cash or EBITDA definitions.
enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.method: Computed as enterprise value divided by yfinance TTM EBITDA converted to the quote currency. The raw Yahoo/yfinance enterpriseToEbitda provider field is retained separately and is not displayed when this gate fails.
enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance enterpriseValue, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

financialInputEvidence.currencyBasis: Provider field currency contract; component accounting definitions unverified

dividendYield.label: Dividend yield
dividendYield.limitation: Dividend yield uses yfinance annual dividend rate divided by the cached price when both inputs are available.
dividendYield.method: Computed as annual dividend rate divided by cached price, shown as percent.
dividendYield.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance dividendRate and cached price

enterpriseToEbitda.label: EV/EBITDA
enterpriseToEbitda.limitation: EV currency/component bridge is unverified. No corrected valuation is substituted; passing arithmetic does not reconcile leases, minorities, restricted cash or EBITDA definitions.
enterpriseToEbitda.method: Computed as enterprise value divided by yfinance TTM EBITDA converted to the quote currency. The raw Yahoo/yfinance enterpriseToEbitda provider field is retained separately and is not displayed when this gate fails.
enterpriseToEbitda.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance enterpriseValue, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

enterpriseToRevenue.label: EV/revenue
enterpriseToRevenue.limitation: EV currency/component bridge is unverified. No corrected valuation is substituted; passing arithmetic does not reconcile leases, minorities, restricted cash or EBITDA definitions.
enterpriseToRevenue.method: Computed as enterprise value divided by yfinance TTM revenue converted to the quote currency.
enterpriseToRevenue.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance quote fields, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

evToEbit.label: EV/EBIT
evToEbit.limitation: Known issuer release is not covered by every quarterly statement table. A partial newer period cannot qualify full filing coverage; figures and accounting definitions remain unverified.
evToEbit.method: EV/EBIT is intentionally unavailable until EBIT can be computed from an explicit, reviewed source path.

forwardPE.label: Forward P/E
forwardPE.limitation: Known issuer release is not covered by every quarterly statement table. A partial newer period cannot qualify full filing coverage; figures and accounting definitions remain unverified.
forwardPE.method: Computed as cached share price divided by yfinance forward EPS estimate.
forwardPE.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance price and forward EPS estimate fields

pnAv.label: P/NAV
pnAv.limitation: Known issuer release is not covered by every quarterly statement table. A partial newer period cannot qualify full filing coverage; figures and accounting definitions remain unverified.
pnAv.method: NAV requires explicit source-linked fleet/assets, debt, cash, currency, and timestamp inputs. It is not inferred from sector labels or P/B.

priceToBook.label: P/B
priceToBook.limitation: Known issuer release is not covered by every quarterly statement table. A partial newer period cannot qualify full filing coverage; figures and accounting definitions remain unverified.
priceToBook.method: Computed as cached share price divided by yfinance book value per share.
priceToBook.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance price and bookValue fields

priceToSalesTrailing12Months.label: P/S
priceToSalesTrailing12Months.limitation: Known issuer release is not covered by every quarterly statement table. A partial newer period cannot qualify full filing coverage; figures and accounting definitions remain unverified.
priceToSalesTrailing12Months.method: Computed as market cap divided by yfinance TTM revenue converted to the quote currency.
priceToSalesTrailing12Months.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance quote fields, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

targetUpsidePct.label: Target-derived fields
targetUpsidePct.limitation: Target rows are provider/manual source rows. Reported analyst references may overlap and are not deduplicated.
targetUpsidePct.method: Unknown from Yahoo/yfinance response. Treat as a third-party consensus field and verify against other sources.

trailingPE.label: TTM P/E
trailingPE.limitation: Known issuer release is not covered by every quarterly statement table. A partial newer period cannot qualify full filing coverage; figures and accounting definitions remain unverified.
trailingPE.method: Computed as cached share price divided by yfinance trailing EPS.
trailingPE.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance price and EPS fields

issues: Provider statements remain June-limited and are preserved separately.
No primary TTM EPS or shares bridge; EPS-dependent multiples remain withheld.
Reported operating income is not labelled standardized EBIT.
Capex including software and capitalized development are separate cash-flow facts; no generic FCF is manufactured.
Original report rounding is retained; no balancing plugs.
Primary fields do not reconcile provider enterprise value, lease/perimeter treatment or EBITDA definition.
primaryFinancials.limitation: Reviewed transcriptions and explicit bridges only; no whole-report or accounting-definition verification implied.

quarterlyStatements.limitations: Open/free yfinance quarterly statement tables are screening-grade, rate-limited, and may lag or omit line items. Values are shown only when a dated quarterly statement row is returned; no statement history is inferred from current yfinance summary fields. Currency is shown only when yfinance provides financialCurrency.
quarterlyStatements.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance quarterly statement tables

enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.label: EV/EBITDA
enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.limitation: EV currency/component bridge is unverified. No corrected valuation is substituted; passing arithmetic does not reconcile leases, minorities, restricted cash or EBITDA definitions.
enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.method: Computed as enterprise value divided by yfinance TTM EBITDA converted to the quote currency. The raw Yahoo/yfinance enterpriseToEbitda provider field is retained separately and is not displayed when this gate fails.
enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance enterpriseValue, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

financialInputEvidence.currencyBasis: Provider field currency contract; component accounting definitions unverified

dividendYield.label: Dividend yield
dividendYield.limitation: Dividend yield uses yfinance annual dividend rate divided by the cached price when both inputs are available.
dividendYield.method: Computed as annual dividend rate divided by cached price, shown as percent.
dividendYield.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance dividendRate and cached price

enterpriseToEbitda.label: EV/EBITDA
enterpriseToEbitda.limitation: EV currency/component bridge is unverified. No corrected valuation is substituted; passing arithmetic does not reconcile leases, minorities, restricted cash or EBITDA definitions.
enterpriseToEbitda.method: Computed as enterprise value divided by yfinance TTM EBITDA converted to the quote currency. The raw Yahoo/yfinance enterpriseToEbitda provider field is retained separately and is not displayed when this gate fails.
enterpriseToEbitda.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance enterpriseValue, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

enterpriseToRevenue.label: EV/revenue
enterpriseToRevenue.limitation: EV currency/component bridge is unverified. No corrected valuation is substituted; passing arithmetic does not reconcile leases, minorities, restricted cash or EBITDA definitions.
enterpriseToRevenue.method: Computed as enterprise value divided by yfinance TTM revenue converted to the quote currency.
enterpriseToRevenue.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance quote fields, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

evToEbit.label: EV/EBIT
evToEbit.limitation: EV/EBIT is intentionally unavailable until EBIT can be computed from an explicit, reviewed source path.
evToEbit.method: EV/EBIT is intentionally unavailable until EBIT can be computed from an explicit, reviewed source path.

forwardPE.label: Forward P/E
forwardPE.limitation: Forward EPS is an estimate field with unverified methodology and contributor coverage.
forwardPE.method: Computed as cached share price divided by yfinance forward EPS estimate.
forwardPE.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance price and forward EPS estimate fields

pnAv.label: P/NAV
pnAv.limitation: NAV requires explicit source-linked fleet/assets, debt, cash, currency, and timestamp inputs. It is not inferred from sector labels or P/B.
pnAv.method: NAV requires explicit source-linked fleet/assets, debt, cash, currency, and timestamp inputs. It is not inferred from sector labels or P/B.

priceToBook.label: P/B
priceToBook.limitation: Book value is not NAV, replacement value, fleet value, or reviewed accounting equity.
priceToBook.method: Computed as cached share price divided by yfinance book value per share.
priceToBook.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance price and bookValue fields

priceToSalesTrailing12Months.label: P/S
priceToSalesTrailing12Months.limitation: Revenue multiples need margin, growth, sector, and accounting context.
priceToSalesTrailing12Months.method: Computed as market cap divided by yfinance TTM revenue converted to the quote currency.
priceToSalesTrailing12Months.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance quote fields, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

targetUpsidePct.label: Target-derived fields
targetUpsidePct.limitation: Target rows are provider/manual source rows. Reported analyst references may overlap and are not deduplicated.
targetUpsidePct.method: Dated, source-reviewed rows with matching currency, vintage and horizon; descriptive target/price gap, not expected return. Raw unqualified targets remain in source details.

trailingPE.label: TTM P/E
trailingPE.limitation: Trailing EPS can differ from company adjusted EPS and may include one-offs.
trailingPE.method: Computed as cached share price divided by yfinance trailing EPS.
trailingPE.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance price and EPS fields

issues: Provider statements remain June-limited and are preserved separately.
No primary TTM EPS or shares bridge; EPS-dependent multiples remain withheld.
Reported operating income is not labelled standardized EBIT.
Capex including software and capitalized development are separate cash-flow facts; no generic FCF is manufactured.
Original report rounding is retained; no balancing plugs.
Primary fields do not reconcile provider enterprise value, lease/perimeter treatment or EBITDA definition.
primaryFinancials.limitation: Reviewed transcriptions and explicit bridges only; no whole-report or accounting-definition verification implied.

quarterlyStatements.limitations: Open/free yfinance quarterly statement tables are screening-grade, rate-limited, and may lag or omit line items. Values are shown only when a dated quarterly statement row is returned; no statement history is inferred from current yfinance summary fields. Currency is shown only when yfinance provides financialCurrency.
quarterlyStatements.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance quarterly statement tables

enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.label: EV/EBITDA
enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.limitation: EV currency/component bridge is unverified. No corrected valuation is substituted; passing arithmetic does not reconcile leases, minorities, restricted cash or EBITDA definitions.
enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.method: Computed as enterprise value divided by yfinance TTM EBITDA converted to the quote currency. The raw Yahoo/yfinance enterpriseToEbitda provider field is retained separately and is not displayed when this gate fails.
enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance enterpriseValue, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

financialInputEvidence.currencyBasis: Provider field currency contract; component accounting definitions unverified

dividendYield.label: Dividend yield
dividendYield.limitation: Dividend yield uses yfinance annual dividend rate divided by the cached price when both inputs are available.
dividendYield.method: Computed as annual dividend rate divided by cached price, shown as percent.
dividendYield.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance dividendRate and cached price

enterpriseToEbitda.label: EV/EBITDA
enterpriseToEbitda.limitation: EV currency/component bridge is unverified. No corrected valuation is substituted; passing arithmetic does not reconcile leases, minorities, restricted cash or EBITDA definitions.
enterpriseToEbitda.method: Computed as enterprise value divided by yfinance TTM EBITDA converted to the quote currency. The raw Yahoo/yfinance enterpriseToEbitda provider field is retained separately and is not displayed when this gate fails.
enterpriseToEbitda.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance enterpriseValue, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

enterpriseToRevenue.label: EV/revenue
enterpriseToRevenue.limitation: EV currency/component bridge is unverified. No corrected valuation is substituted; passing arithmetic does not reconcile leases, minorities, restricted cash or EBITDA definitions.
enterpriseToRevenue.method: Computed as enterprise value divided by yfinance TTM revenue converted to the quote currency.
enterpriseToRevenue.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance quote fields, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

evToEbit.label: EV/EBIT
evToEbit.limitation: EV/EBIT is intentionally unavailable until EBIT can be computed from an explicit, reviewed source path.
evToEbit.method: EV/EBIT is intentionally unavailable until EBIT can be computed from an explicit, reviewed source path.

forwardPE.label: Forward P/E
forwardPE.limitation: Forward EPS is an estimate field with unverified methodology and contributor coverage.
forwardPE.method: Computed as cached share price divided by yfinance forward EPS estimate.
forwardPE.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance price and forward EPS estimate fields

pnAv.label: P/NAV
pnAv.limitation: NAV requires explicit source-linked fleet/assets, debt, cash, currency, and timestamp inputs. It is not inferred from sector labels or P/B.
pnAv.method: NAV requires explicit source-linked fleet/assets, debt, cash, currency, and timestamp inputs. It is not inferred from sector labels or P/B.

priceToBook.label: P/B
priceToBook.limitation: Book value is not NAV, replacement value, fleet value, or reviewed accounting equity.
priceToBook.method: Computed as cached share price divided by yfinance book value per share.
priceToBook.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance price and bookValue fields

priceToSalesTrailing12Months.label: P/S
priceToSalesTrailing12Months.limitation: Revenue multiples need margin, growth, sector, and accounting context.
priceToSalesTrailing12Months.method: Computed as market cap divided by yfinance TTM revenue converted to the quote currency.
priceToSalesTrailing12Months.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance quote fields, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

targetUpsidePct.label: Target-derived fields
targetUpsidePct.limitation: Target rows are provider/manual source rows. Reported analyst references may overlap and are not deduplicated.
targetUpsidePct.method: Dated, source-reviewed rows with matching currency, vintage and horizon; descriptive target/price gap, not expected return. Raw unqualified targets remain in source details.

trailingPE.label: TTM P/E
trailingPE.limitation: Trailing EPS can differ from company adjusted EPS and may include one-offs.
trailingPE.method: Computed as cached share price divided by yfinance trailing EPS.
trailingPE.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance price and EPS fields

issues: Provider statements remain June-limited and are preserved separately.

Reported operating income is not labelled standardized EBIT.
Capex including software and capitalized development are separate cash-flow facts; no generic FCF is manufactured.
Original report rounding is retained; no balancing plugs.

quarterlyStatements.limitations: Open/free yfinance quarterly statement tables are screening-grade, rate-limited, and may lag or omit line items. Values are shown only when a dated quarterly statement row is returned; no statement history is inferred from current yfinance summary fields. Currency is shown only when yfinance provides financialCurrency.
quarterlyStatements.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance quarterly statement tables

enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.label: EV/EBITDA
enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.limitation: EV currency/component bridge is unverified. No corrected valuation is substituted; passing arithmetic does not reconcile leases, minorities, restricted cash or EBITDA definitions.
enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.method: Computed as enterprise value divided by yfinance TTM EBITDA converted to the quote currency. The raw Yahoo/yfinance enterpriseToEbitda provider field is retained separately and is not displayed when this gate fails.
enterpriseToEbitdaInputs.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance enterpriseValue, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

financialInputEvidence.currencyBasis: Provider field currency contract; component accounting definitions unverified

dividendYield.label: Dividend yield
dividendYield.limitation: Dividend yield uses yfinance annual dividend rate divided by the cached price when both inputs are available.
dividendYield.method: Computed as annual dividend rate divided by cached price, shown as percent.
dividendYield.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance dividendRate and cached price

enterpriseToEbitda.label: EV/EBITDA
enterpriseToEbitda.limitation: EV currency/component bridge is unverified. No corrected valuation is substituted; passing arithmetic does not reconcile leases, minorities, restricted cash or EBITDA definitions.
enterpriseToEbitda.method: Computed as enterprise value divided by yfinance TTM EBITDA converted to the quote currency. The raw Yahoo/yfinance enterpriseToEbitda provider field is retained separately and is not displayed when this gate fails.
enterpriseToEbitda.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance enterpriseValue, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

enterpriseToRevenue.label: EV/revenue
enterpriseToRevenue.limitation: EV currency/component bridge is unverified. No corrected valuation is substituted; passing arithmetic does not reconcile leases, minorities, restricted cash or EBITDA definitions.
enterpriseToRevenue.method: Computed as enterprise value divided by yfinance TTM revenue converted to the quote currency.
enterpriseToRevenue.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance quote fields, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

evToEbit.label: EV/EBIT
evToEbit.limitation: EV/EBIT is intentionally unavailable until EBIT can be computed from an explicit, reviewed source path.
evToEbit.method: EV/EBIT is intentionally unavailable until EBIT can be computed from an explicit, reviewed source path.

forwardPE.label: Forward P/E
forwardPE.limitation: Forward EPS is an estimate field with unverified methodology and contributor coverage.
forwardPE.method: Computed as cached share price divided by yfinance forward EPS estimate.
forwardPE.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance price and forward EPS estimate fields

pnAv.label: P/NAV
pnAv.limitation: NAV requires explicit source-linked fleet/assets, debt, cash, currency, and timestamp inputs. It is not inferred from sector labels or P/B.
pnAv.method: NAV requires explicit source-linked fleet/assets, debt, cash, currency, and timestamp inputs. It is not inferred from sector labels or P/B.

priceToBook.label: P/B
priceToBook.limitation: Book value is not NAV, replacement value, fleet value, or reviewed accounting equity.
priceToBook.method: Computed as cached share price divided by yfinance book value per share.
priceToBook.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance price and bookValue fields

priceToSalesTrailing12Months.label: P/S
priceToSalesTrailing12Months.limitation: Revenue multiples need margin, growth, sector, and accounting context.
priceToSalesTrailing12Months.method: Computed as market cap divided by yfinance TTM revenue converted to the quote currency.
priceToSalesTrailing12Months.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance quote fields, ttm_income_stmt, and FX where needed

targetUpsidePct.label: Target-derived fields
targetUpsidePct.limitation: Target rows are provider/manual source rows. Reported analyst references may overlap and are not deduplicated.
targetUpsidePct.method: Dated, source-reviewed rows with matching currency, vintage and horizon; descriptive target/price gap, not expected return. Raw unqualified targets remain in source details.

trailingPE.label: TTM P/E
trailingPE.limitation: Trailing EPS can differ from company adjusted EPS and may include one-offs.
trailingPE.method: Computed as cached share price divided by yfinance trailing EPS.
trailingPE.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance price and EPS fields
